_comment: Mneme Memory System — Configuration. Copy to config.json and fill in your API keys.

api_keys._openai_note: Not needed for new installs — embeddings run locally by default (retrieval.embedding_provider: 'local'). Only fill this in if you manually set embedding_provider to 'openai'.

storage._profile_note: Switch between memory databases: 'main', 'testing', etc. Each gets its own data folder.
storage._path_note: Relative paths resolve against Mneme's home folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Mneme, or the app folder for legacy installs; MNEME_HOME env var overrides). Absolute paths are used as-is.
storage._cloud_backup_note: Optional extra backup location, e.g. a cloud-synced folder. Supports {profile}. Leave blank to disable.

identity._user_name_note: Your name (used in timeline summaries and entity extraction). Defaults to 'Human'.

model._default_note: Main conversation model. Also works: claude-fable-5 (premium model; requires an API tier with Fable access and 30-day data retention — not available for zero-data-retention orgs), claude-sonnet-5, claude-opus-4-8, claude-opus-4-7, claude-opus-4-6, claude-opus-4-5, claude-sonnet-4-5, claude-haiku-4-5
model._testing_note: Cheap model for development. Used when use_testing is true.
model._temperature_note: Response randomness (0–1). Ignored when thinking is enabled (Anthropic requires 1.0).
model._max_tokens_note: Max output tokens per response. 16k handles long responses and artifacts. Increase if responses get cut off.
model._streaming_note: Real-time streaming responses via SSE. Strongly recommended.

thinking._enabled_note: Extended thinking (chain-of-thought) before responses. Requires streaming.
thinking._budget_note: Max tokens for thinking. model.max_tokens must be larger than this. Higher = deeper reasoning but more cost.

context._recent_note: Maximum recent conversation history to keep active. Standard 200k-context models are capped at 125k; 1M-context models can use larger windows. Mneme may include less when needed to keep room for replies, files, and memory search.
context._duplicate_note: Don't retrieve the same memory twice within this window.

retrieval._embedding_provider_note: 'local' — built-in on-device embeddings (BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 via ONNX), no OpenAI key needed, ~35MB one-time download on first use. 'openai' — requires api_keys.openai, uses embeddings_model below. New installs default to 'local'; existing configs without this key keep using 'openai'.
retrieval._max_results_note: Maximum memories to retrieve per query. More = better recall but higher costs.
retrieval._threshold_note: Minimum semantic similarity (0-1). 0.50 suits the built-in local model (bge-small-en-v1.5). Measured on the actual retrieval path (asymmetric: generate_query_embedding(query) with the BGE query prefix vs. generate_embedding(message) with no prefix — not symmetric sentence-to-sentence cosine): related query->message pairs scored ~0.54-0.75, unrelated pairs ~0.31-0.53. The two ranges overlap slightly (~0.53-0.54), so the threshold sits at the low end of the true-match range to favor recall — a missed match reads to users as 'memory is broken', while an extra false-positive just wastes a bit of context. Use ~0.25 if embedding_provider is 'openai' (text-embedding-3-small's cosine distribution is much tighter).
retrieval._weights_note: Retrieval score = (semantic × ~0.34) + (importance × ~0.34) + (recency × ~0.17) + (entity_match × 0.15). entity_match combines keyword hits in message content with entity-link confidence when an entity name/alias appears in the query. Set to 0 to disable. Other weights rescale automatically.
retrieval._archive_note: Messages older than this go to deep archive (requires @recall --deep to search).
retrieval._embedding_note: Generate embeddings immediately after each message.

caching._enabled_note: Adaptive prompt caching. Saves 50–70% on active conversations, no penalty on sparse usage.
caching._threshold_note: Skip caching if no messages for this long (avoids paying write premium on cold starts). 0 = always cache.
caching._transition_note: Align tier transitions with cache expiry (55min = 5min before 1h cache expires).

concepts._enabled_note: Narrative concept layer — keyword-triggered interpretive meta-memories.
concepts._window_note: Recent messages to scan for keyword matches.
concepts._frequency_note: Prompt AI to check for new concepts every N messages.

attachments._enabled_note: File attachments — images, PDF, text, JSON.
attachments._reminder_note: Remind AI to describe files that lack descriptions.

storage._dimension_note: Resize larger images (1568 optimal for Claude vision).

entity_summaries._enabled_note: Automatically generated historical context per entity. Also enables entity extraction and @entity commands.
entity_summaries._extract_note: Automatically extract entities from new messages.
entity_summaries._update_note: After this many incremental updates, regenerate summary from scratch.

timeline._enabled_note: 7-day rolling window of daily summaries for temporal context.

notes._enabled_note: Persistent AI-managed notes organized in named sections.
notes._cleanup_note: Show cleanup warning when notes exceed this % of max_tokens.
notes._interval_note: Inject cleanup reminder every N messages. 0 to disable.

commands._iterations_note: Max AI continuation loops per message (prevents infinite command loops).
commands._autonomy_note: Parameters the AI can adjust via @config without user approval.

costs._budget_note: Alert when monthly costs approach this amount. Adjust to your expected usage: ~$3-8 on Haiku, ~$30-60 on Sonnet, $100-180+ on heavy Sonnet with thinking.
costs._alert_note: Alert when this fraction of budget is reached (0.8 = 80%).
costs._tracking_note: Log all API costs to help monitor spending.

system._auto_backup_note: Create a SQLite snapshot on server startup using VACUUM INTO. Uses storage.backup_path and optional storage.cloud_backup_path.
system._backup_keep_note: How many startup backup snapshots to keep in each backup location.
system._debug_note: Enable /api/debug/* endpoints (disabled by default for security).
system._keep_pc_awake_note: Prevent system sleep while the server is running, so phones/other devices can stay connected over Tailscale. Windows-only; no-ops elsewhere. Display can still turn off.
